name: Notice of Charter Application Decision
description: Written notice of approval or denial of a charter application, including reasons and deficiencies if denied.
recipient: Applicant, PA Department of Education, State Charter School Appeal Board
deadline: no later than 75 days after the first public hearing (decision deadline)
quote: Written notice of the Board's decision shall be sent to the applicant, Department of Education and the Appeal Board, including reasons for denial and a clear description of application deficiencies if the application is denied.
